title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG The Flute of Summoning Dragon Kaiba SDK-042 Unlimited Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card called "The Flute of Summoning Dragon" from the Starter Deck: Kaiba set. It is a Super Rare Spell card (SDK-042) that features the character Flute of Summoning Dragon. The card is in English and manufactured by Konami for players aged 16 and above.
